{{Short description|Czech nuclear physicist}}
[[File:Biskupské svěcení Z. Wasserbauer 2018-05-19 Vojtěch Petráček 01.jpg|thumb|Vojtěch Petráček]]
'''Vojtěch Petráček''' (born 17 February 1964 in [[Prague]]) is a Czech nuclear physicist and University Lecturer. Since February 2018, He has also been the rector of the [[Czech Technical University in Prague]] (CVUT) in Prague (removed from office by an extraordinary Academic senate motion in 2025 for his "inability to manage").<ref name="cvut">{{cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Rektor a vedení ČVUT - Veřejný web - České vysoké učení technické v Praze|url=https://www.cvut.cz/rektor-a-vedeni-cvut|archive-url=|archive-date=|accessdate=2018-03-22|website=[[Czech Technical University in Prague]]}}</ref>

== Education ==
After attending the [[Nad Štolou Grammar School]] in the [[Letňany]], Petráček studied mathematics and physics from 1982 at the [[Charles University]], obtaining a doctorate in 1987. 

== Career ==
In 2014 he unsuccessfully ran in the Rectorate election of the ČVUT, but in 2017 he was elected and at the end of January. The press widely discussed his behavior deemed unethical, when he voted in his own election and won by a single vote. 2018 he was appointed to this position by the Czech President [[Miloš Zeman]] with effect from 1. February 2018.<ref>[https://www.cvut.cz/sites/default/files/content/759de935-1223-44c7-8629-754aa07462f9/cs/20170426-zivotopis-vojtecha-petracka.pdf CV Vojtěch Petráček] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181215222010/https://www.cvut.cz/sites/default/files/content/759de935-1223-44c7-8629-754aa07462f9/cs/20170426-zivotopis-vojtecha-petracka.pdf |date=2018-12-15 }}  [[Czech Technical University in Prague]] (PDF)</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=2018-01-29|title=Zeman jmenoval rektory vysokých škol. Ceremoniál na Hradě se nekonal|url=https://zpravy.idnes.cz/rektori-vysoke-skoly-milos-zeman-prezident-ceremonial-pi1-/domaci.aspx?c=A180129_143306_domaci_amu|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2018-03-22|website=[[:cz:iDNES.cz|iDNES]]}}</ref>

In May 2025, members of the CTU Academic Senate filed a motion to dismiss the rector due to his inability to manage the university resulting in long-standing deficiencies in the school's management, including problems in budget management and approval, unexplained expenditures for legal and consulting services, preparation of internal regulations, capital construction, quality management, and labor relations.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-05-21 |title=Rektor ČVUT Vojtěch Petráček končí pro svou nehospodárnost. Akademický senát přijal návrh k odvolání |url=https://www.lidovky.cz/domov/akademicky-senat-cvut-odvolal-rektora-petracka.A250521_144904_ln_domov_lvot |access-date=2025-06-03 |website=Lidovky.cz}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-05-21 |title=Akademický senát ČVUT přijal návrh na odvolání rektora Petráčka |url=https://denikn.cz/minuta/1739390/ |access-date=2025-06-03 |website=Deník N |language=cs}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-05-21 |title=Rektor Petráček končí v čele ČVUT. Akademici ho odvolali kvůli hospodaření - Seznam Zprávy |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-zivot-v-cesku-rektor-petracek-konci-v-cele-cvut-akademici-ho-odvolali-kvuli-hospodareni-277187 |access-date=2025-06-02 |website=www.seznamzpravy.cz |language=cs}}</ref> The motion followed a series of court rulings on rector Petráček's illegal behavior resulting in financial and reputational losses to the University.

On 21 May 2025, the Academic Senate of the CTU proposed to the President of the Republic, by 39 votes (out of 44 senators present), to remove Petráček from his position as rector.

On 30 May 2025, Czech President Petr Pavel decided to dismiss Vojtěch Petráček from the rector's office.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-05-30 |title=Pavel odvolal rektora ČVUT Petráčka. Nezvládá hospodaření, upozornil akademický senát |url=https://www.lidovky.cz/domov/pavel-odvolal-rektora-cvut-petracka-jak-navrhl-akademicky-senat.A250530_130330_ln_domov_lsva |access-date=2025-06-02 |website=Lidovky.cz}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=President's Communication |first= |title=Prezident republiky rozhodl o odvolání rektora Českého vysokého učení technického v Praze |url=https://www.hrad.cz/cs/pro-media/tiskove-zpravy/aktualni-tiskove-zpravy/prezident-republiky-rozhodl-o-odvolani-rektora-ceskeho-vysokeho-uceni-technickeho-v-praze-18606 |access-date=2025-06-02 |website=Pražský hrad |language=cs}}</ref> The removal from office was also countersigned (agreed) by the Prime Minister on 4 June 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-06-10 |title=Fiala stvrdil odvolání rektora ČVUT - Novinky |url=https://www.novinky.cz/clanek/domaci-fiala-stvrdil-odvolani-rektora-cvut-40525050 |access-date=2025-06-10 |website=www.novinky.cz |language=cs}}</ref> 

== Publications ==
* Vojtěch Petráček, as of 2018, has co-authored 117 articles (most of them as one among hundreds of co-authors).
